fixed_deck: exact c005 Dragapult deck for every arm/checkpoint/eval/package (immutable)

architecture.policy: cg.rl_policy (c007 V2-A trunk + value head + STOP logit)

action_decoder_semantics.step: one non-forced selection (§9.1); forced (n<=1 / maxCount==0 / min==max==n) bypass, no transition
action_decoder_semantics.fixed_multiselect: sequential masked sampling without replacement (k=min=max picks)
action_decoder_semantics.variable_multiselect: sequential masked sampling + learned STOP logit; up to maxCount picks
action_decoder_semantics.log_prob: sum of sub-step masked log-probs (act()==evaluate() verified)
action_decoder_semantics.ordered: not observed in-deck; if ever observed -> BLOCK (§9.5), never routed silently to teacher
action_decoder_semantics.reward_timing: consecutive trainable steps treated as adjacent for gamma-discounting (forced steps carry no decision value)
action_decoder_semantics.eval_mode: greedy (argmax) — matches deployed inference; rollouts sample stochastically

ppo.rollout_rule: collect until >=128 games AND >=8192 trainable decisions

teacher_replay.loss: masked NLL of teacher action on c007 TRAIN split only (never validation/test)

frozen_reference_kl.anchor: frozen initial V2-A policy, first-step masked distribution

r2_anchors.on_policy_teacher_action: DISABLED — synchronized instrumented-teacher shadow after divergent RL actions is not proven; R2 uses offline replay + reference KL only (§10.3)

opponent_population.lagged_selfplay: after 5,000 games freeze every 5,000; keep 3 most recent; sample uniformly; never the current mutable params

held_out_opponent: Mega Abomasnow — excluded from training, used only in final test eval after checkpoint selection; never influences selection

budgets.note: maxima; early-stop gates bound actual compute; screening games are EVALUATION and do NOT consume the training-game budget

checkpoint_selection.arm_statistic: median across seeds; representative checkpoint by same rule; all seeds reported

R0: teacher<0.15 AND lucario<0.25 AND iono<0.25 at 5000
no blend improvement >2pp over two consecutive evals
R1_R2: after 20000: no blend improvement >1.5pp over three consecutive evals

final_evaluation.reliability: 40 games/seat vs >=3 strategic opponents; zero invalid/exception/timeout; latency P50/95/99/max
final_evaluation.teacher_head_to_head: 200/seat (400) extend by 100 to 800; win=1/draw=.5/loss=0; one-sided 95% LB >= 0.47 to pass
final_evaluation.strategic_field: Lucario, Iono, held-out Abomasnow, Dragapult mirror; control separate; both seats
final_evaluation.major_regression: candidate point <= teacher point - 0.07 AND bootstrap P(regression) >= 90% (blocks submission)
final_evaluation.reproducible_improvement: global field > teacher with 90% interval > 0, OR one matchup >=+5pp @ >=90% with non-inferiority pass and no major regression

submission_gate: SUBMISSION_D=SUBMIT iff BEST_RL_ARM!=NONE AND non-inferiority passes AND reproducible improvement exists AND no major regression AND reliability passes AND package/size/runtime pass. Never submit for rising training reward / beating another RL arm / offline agreement / a lucky seed.

measured_timing.note: RL is inherently non-reproducible (engine random_device + sampling); multi-threaded BLAS used for updates. Honest-negative early-stop path estimated ~4-6h across all arms/seeds.

restart_policy: one complete restart only for a documented implementation defect affecting all comparable runs
